description: This file implements the Thread class for managing platform-specific thread operations, including creation, termination, suspension, priority setting, and naming, within the Thunder::Core namespace. It handles both Windows and POSIX systems, providing thread lifecycle management and exception handling.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: A class encapsulating thread creation, control, and lifecycle management for Windows and POSIX systems, including thread naming, priority, and exception handling.

methods.name: Thread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and starts a thread with specified stack size and name.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread (Linux-specific).

methods.name: StartThread
methods.description: Static method that serves as the thread entry point, executing the thread's main loop.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific resources; default implementation returns success.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Stops the thread and waits for it to finish execution.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Sets the thread state to initialized.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Sets the thread state to stopping.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Sets the thread state to running.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the thread to reach a specific state within a timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Gets or sets the current thread state.

methods.name: ThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread's name for debugging purposes.

methods.name: GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack of the thread (debug build, platform-specific).
